description: This file defines the {@link SubjectNotAccessibleException} class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It signals that a Subject was either not present or access was insufficient due to permission issues, specifically within policy-related contexts. The class includes factory methods for creating instances from message strings or JSON, and it provides a builder class to facilitate constructing exception objects with detailed context.

classes.name: SubjectNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception occur when a Subject is missing or access is denied due to permissions, specifically in policy contexts within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SubjectNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of SubjectNotAccessibleException with fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for SubjectNotAccessibleException, initialized with policy ID, label, and subject ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a SubjectNotAccessibleException from a custom message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubjectNotAccessibleException by parsing the provided JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the provided DittoHeaders applied.
